name: helium10
description: Connect Helium 10 to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Helium 10 MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Helium 10 to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with amazon seller research using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Helium 10 workspace.
Find anything in Helium 10 that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review amazon seller research in Helium 10.
